title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator meeting agent for GCC
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap's planned GCC release and licence requirement. Microsoft documentation supports the control paths, commands and general Facilitator behaviour; the briefing distinguishes these from GCC-specific details that remain unpublished.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to bring Facilitator to Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC.
claims.quote: Facilitator is coming to Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC.

claims.claim: Learn describes Facilitator generally but does not document its GCC-specific behaviour as of November 2026.

claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "GCC". Read the full Feature availability table at learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-copilot; it has no Facilitator row.

claims.claim: Watermarks are not applied to Facilitator responses or AI-generated meeting notes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Loop experiences in Teams control AI-generated meeting notes separately.
claims.quote: Loop experiences in Teams control AI-generated notes for meetings, which are enabled by default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: The AI-generated notes control uses the IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled PowerShell setting.
claims.quote: You can manage this control using the `IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled` setting in PowerShell.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies to the whole tenant.
claims.quote: Collaborative meeting notes | `IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled` (boolean) | This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This setting applies to your entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Disabling this setting turns off AI-generated meeting notes for every user in the organisation.
claims.quote: This means that if you disable this setting, AI-generated notes for meetings is turned off for all users in your organization.

Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams and learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing; no Facilitator-specific price found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No Facilitator-specific meter is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator license pricing meter capacity limit Copilot credits; "Facilitator" "available capacity" pricing. Read Facilitator licensing and Copilot Studio Billing rates and management search text; no meter identified for this meeting feature.

claims.claim: No Facilitator-specific capacity figure is published, and its Learn page does not quantify available capacity.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator license pricing meter capacity limit Copilot credits; "Facilitator" "available capacity" pricing. Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams; licensing says subject to available capacity without a figure. No Facilitator-specific figure found.

claims.claim: The documented management procedure uses Teams admin credentials in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Teams admin center with your Teams admin credentials.

claims.claim: The allow/block path is Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked $true is a documented MicrosoftTeams PowerShell call controlling app state in the tenant.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module. ... Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -IsBlocked $true ... -IsBlocked ... The state of the app in the tenant.

claims.claim: The app availability path through Manage apps, Facilitator, Users and groups, Availability, Edit availability and Available to is documented.
claims.quote: Select the Users and groups tab. ... Under Select to manage who this app is installed for or available to in your organization, select Availability. ... Select Edit availability. ... Select the required option from Available to menu.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -AppAssignmentType Everyone sets an app's availability to Everyone.
claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone ... Updates the availability value for Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b) to Everyone.

claims.claim: App-centric management is documented for assigning Facilitator availability to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can then assign the policy to your entire tenant or to a select group of users. Follow the instructions at Add or modify app availability for users to assign the policy to users using app-centric management.

claims.claim: App availability changes take up to 24 hours to take effect.
claims.quote: It takes up to 24 hours for the availability changes to take effect.

claims.claim: In rare cases app availability changes can take up to six days to reflect in the client.
claims.quote: In rare cases, it might take up to six days for the changes to reflect in the client.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The default state on arrival in GCC is not stated, so defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams GCC default availability permissions identity notes limitations; "Facilitator" "GCC". Read roadmap description and learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams; no GCC rollout default found, distinct from Learn's general allowed-by-default statement.

claims.claim: The medium cost rating reflects the required Copilot add-on licence for users who initiate Facilitator.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is an add-on plan with specific licensing prerequisites.
